translate_en|mods/TrippingZombies/42/med:
Maximum delay in game ticks between trip evaluations for a zombie (~60 ticks = 1 second). Cooldowns are randomized between min and max.
Default: 150 ticks.

Minimum delay in game ticks between trip evaluations for a zombie (~60 ticks = 1 second).
Default: 100 ticks.

Percentage chance a moving zombie trips when walking over a corpse on the ground. Turns killzones and corpse piles into physical obstacles.
Default: 23%% (0 = Disabled).

Percentage chance a tripping zombie breaks its legs on impact and becomes a crawler upon standing back up.
Default: 0%% (Disabled).

Allows sneaking players behind unaware zombies to perform critical ambush executions with knives, blades, and heavy weapons.
Default: Off (Opt-in).

Enables physical ragdoll collapses on fatal melee and gunshot hits with sub-tile wall and vehicle collision detection to prevent clipping.
Default: On.
Master switch for the entire mod. Turn off to disable all tripping and knockdown logic without removing the mod from your save.
Comma-separated animation variables or ModData tags to exempt custom NPC mods from tripping. Built-in: Bandit, SurvivorNPC, NotAloneBody, md:ProjectALifeOwned.

Percentage chance a gunshot hit knocks a living zombie to the ground.
Default: 22%% (0 = Disabled).

Off (Default): Gunshots always use the exact configured Firearm Knockdown Chance percentage regardless of weapon.
On: Dynamically scales knockdown chance based on bullet caliber and kinetic power relative to the set percentage (scales from 10%% for .22/9mm to 40%% for 12g shotguns when base is 22%%). Integrates with Viewpoint True Ballistics.

Game ticks a hit reaction plays before the zombie falls to the floor (~60 ticks = 1 second). Allows realistic impact stagger before collapse.
Default: 2 ticks.

Percentage chance a shove or melee weapon hit knocks a zombie to the floor. Directional falls pitch away from the attacker.
Default: 8%% (0 = Disabled).

Percentage chance a zombie trips when stepping onto another zombie already sprawled on the ground, creating dogpiles and chain reactions.
Default: 30%% (0 = Disabled).

Percentage chance any fall becomes a full dynamic physics ragdoll instead of an animated fall. Requires 'Use Physics Hit Reactions' in game options. Works in singleplayer and multiplayer (with Ragdolls in MP).
Default: 100%% (0 = Animated Only).

Off (Default): Any moving zombie can trip, including wandering and migrating hordes.
On: Only zombies actively chasing a visible player can trip.
Damps limb flailing and anchors arms and feet during falls so ragdoll extremities drop naturally under gravity instead of violently whipping around.

Percentage chance a zombie loses its footing mid-flight while chasing up or down stairs. Rolled once per staircase.
Default: 8%% (0 = Disabled). Stays active even when Proper Ragdolls is enabled.

Dynamically scales melee and shove knockdowns using the player's Strength perk level and heavy weapon weight modifiers. True range scales from 3%% (Strength 0 knife) to 30%% (Strength 10 sledgehammer) when base chance is 8%%.
Default: Off (Opt-in).

Controls the physical severity of trips.
Stumble: Brief stagger forward, no ground fall.
Trip: Sprinters tumble forward at speed; shamblers fall flat.
Knockdown: Forceful ground knockdown with extended getup recovery.

Audible sound radius in tiles generated when a falling body hits the floor, alerting nearby zombies.
Default: 0 (Silent).

On (Default): Close-range lunging attackers can trip and lose their footing.
Off: Zombies in active attack/lunge state will not trip.

Percentage chance a moving fast shambler trips when colliding with another zombie in a horde.
Default: 10%% (0 = Disabled, 100 = Guaranteed).

Percentage chance a moving slow shambler trips when colliding with another zombie in a horde.
Default: 4%% (0 = Disabled, 100 = Guaranteed).

Percentage chance a moving sprinter trips when colliding with another zombie in a horde.
Default: 50%% (0 = Disabled, 100 = Guaranteed).

Percentage chance a moving fast shambler loses its footing on clear, open ground on periodic cooldown rolls.
Default: 4%% (0 = Disabled, 100 = Guaranteed).

Percentage chance a moving slow shambler loses its footing on clear, open ground on periodic cooldown rolls.
Default: 2%% (0 = Disabled, 100 = Guaranteed).

Percentage chance a moving sprinter loses its footing on clear, open ground on periodic cooldown rolls.
Default: 7%% (0 = Disabled, 100 = Guaranteed).
